summary: Full backend + mobile UI testing of TeachOps. Backend pytest: 25/25 passing (auth, demo-login, me, my-day for all 3 roles, schedule, session roster+403, attendance submit gating, inbox role scoping, leave create+decide approve/reject/409/400/403, chat conversations+messages+compose+404 non-member, notifications read-all, pay list+detail+cross-teacher 403). Frontend mobile UI (390x844): login demo buttons navigate to My Day, header role switcher toggles teacher/coordinator/admin, Schedule renders week chips and sessions, Session workspace supports attendance + Submit (status Completed), Inbox Approve + Reject-with-reason modal with toast confirmation, Compose creates new conversation and routes to thread, Thread send works, Leave screen renders with pickers, Notifications screen lists approvals/replies, Pay list + detailed statement with calculation breakdown render correctly. No deprecated expo packages, no SafeAreaView issues, no red-screen errors. Minor cosmetic: a brief burst of 401s on first mount after login when react-query fires before the Authorization header is set in AuthContext (requests auto-retry and succeed).

minor.issue: When session belongs to a different organisation the API returns 404 (correct) but when session is in same org and teacher is not assigned it returns 403 as expected. Behavior correct; no fix needed, just noting the 403 vs 404 branching.

integration_issues.issue: A few protected endpoints (my-day, notifications, pay) sometimes fire with no Authorization header on the very first render after demo-login/role-switch, producing 3-4 CONSOLE 401 errors in the browser. React-query refetches shortly after and succeeds, so no visible UX impact, but noise in logs. Suggest gating queries with `enabled: !!token` in AuthContext consumers.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with the new boxShadow API in RN 0.76+ for web parity.

Console warnings: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from the Reject modal / toast animations. Low priority, but migrate pointerEvents to style and either remove useNativeDriver on web or wrap in Platform check.

action_items: Optional: in AuthContext/useQuery consumers, add `enabled: !!token` so protected GETs don't fire before Bearer header is attached (removes transient 401 console noise after demo-login/role switch).
Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to clear RN web warnings.
Optional: add `data-testid="day-chip-<date>"` to schedule day chips (currently reachable only by text/position).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~680 lines) — close to the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, my_day, schedule, sessions, inbox, chat, pay) before growing further.
All MongoDB reads already exclude _id via projection. Good.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev string if env is missing — fine for demo, but add a startup assertion for production (DEMO_MODE=false).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Tests use the existing idempotent seed (anjali/suresh/meenakshi @teachops.demo, password Demo@12345). Tests create a few TEST_-labelled leave requests and conversations; they do not interfere with normal flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_teachops_api.py and use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Demo mode is enabled; use POST /api/auth/demo-login {role: Teacher|Coordinator|Administrator}. The seed is anchored to the current week, so schedule/my-day always have content. Note: the first-returned teacher session may be in 'Verified' state (seed) which blocks attendance edits with 409; use the `editable=True` helper in the test file when exercising attendance/submit flows.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking functionality. The 401 bursts after login are a react-query timing nit (queries fire before Authorization header is injected). Mitigation: gate protected queries with `enabled: !!token` or add a short delay/suspense boundary around the authenticated layout.
